From: Ariel Diaz <ariel@launchlift.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sandbox credits -> committed path question

Neha —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We have about $12k in cohort sandbox credits remaining for LaunchLift (cohort #7) and leadership is asking whether we can convert those credits into a discounted committed package if we plan to move to production over the next 3–6 months. A few specifics: we expect initial usage of ~200k tokens/month in month 1, ramping to ~750k by month 4.

Questions:
- Can Redwood allow a partial conversion of credits to a time-boxed commitment rather than a straight cash refund?
- Is there a granular/prorated discount for staged commitments (e.g., 3mo pilot then 6mo commit)?
- Any promotional top-up or onboarding credits available if we sign while in the accelerator?

Our procurement/legal team will need a clear billing path (invoice vs credit reconciliation) and a simple term sheet. Would appreciate a short proposal we can share internally.

Cheers,
Ariel Diaz
COO, LaunchLift
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Ariel Diaz <ariel@launchlift.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sandbox credits -> committed path question

Ariel —

Really appreciate the context. Short answer: yes, we can support a staged conversion and make a packaging exception for accelerator cohorts in cases like this. I've sketched two practical options below and attached a simple pricing spreadsheet to illustrate.

Option A — 3mo pilot (no commit) -> 6mo committed conversion:
- Pilot months: use sandbox credits as-is; no invoice.
- On conversion to 6mo commit within 10 days of pilot close: apply a 20% unit discount on token rates for the 6mo tranche, and convert remaining sandbox credits into the first invoice credit (prorated).

Option B — Immediate partial commit + ramping schedule:
- Commit to 25% of expected monthly peak for 6 months (billed monthly).
- Apply a 15% baseline discount + onboarding bonus of up to $1k in promo credits if contract countersigned within 7 business days.

Next steps I recommend: you confirm expected monthly spend profile (sample numbers you gave are perfect), and I’ll loop Finance + Legal to produce a short term sheet. If you prefer a single invoice path we can convert remaining credits to a prepayment line item and reconcile in month 1.

I’ve cc’d Jordan (sales lead) to review commercial margins and Laura (revops) for billing ops. Attaching pricing_spreadsheet.xlsx with modeled tiers.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Neha —

Thanks — Option B sounds closest to what our CFO prefers (partial immediate commit + ramp). A couple of clarifications from our side:
- We would want a 3-month ramp schedule defined in the term sheet (month-by-month committed minimums).
- Billing preference: invoice to LaunchLift (we'll treat existing credits as a prepay/credit balance that reduces invoice totals).
- Legal: short term sheet showing pricing, commitment floors, and a 30-day opt-out for the first month of the committed tranche.

Can you also show how the promo credits would be applied (applied against the first invoice or as token-usage top-up)?

If you can share a draft term sheet I’ll route to our procurement/legal for a quick review.

— Ariel (ops)
